first_semantic_divergence.finding: The normalized graph differs at codegen_entry but deterministic PCode text does not; neither object output differs.
first_semantic_divergence.inference: The extra masks have been made semantically irrelevant before the first available PCode snapshot. The current capture does not decode frontend IR, so it cannot identify which individual frontend rewrite removed them.

responsible_pass_behavior.behavior: IRO_OptimizeFunction runs the O2 IR pass sequence before CodeGen_Generator. Its observed output has one 16-bit zext and no surviving redundant-and operation.
responsible_pass_behavior.name: IRO_OptimizeFunction
responsible_pass_behavior.not_claimed: No individual subpass is credited with deleting the redundant masks: the GDB trace proves these candidates execute at O2, but no decoded frontend-IR before/after capture exists.

source_before_frontend_optimization.baseline: static int extend_short(short value) { return (int)value; } return extend_short((short)value) + extend_short((short)value) + extend_short((short)value);
source_before_frontend_optimization.variant: static int extend_with_cast(int value) { return (int)(short)value; } return extend_with_cast(value) + extend_with_cast(value) + extend_with_cast(value);

responsible_pass_behavior.behavior: The frontend preserves the type-conversion location into code generation: a short formal makes each caller argument a sext, whereas an int formal moves the repeated sext into the helper body.
responsible_pass_behavior.name: IRO_OptimizeFunction
responsible_pass_behavior.not_claimed: The evidence does not show that a named optimization subpass creates this difference. It is already present at the first observable PCode stage, so a claim that copy propagation or constant folding caused it would be unsupported.

source_before_frontend_optimization.result_local: int result; if (left && right) result = 1; else result = 0; return result;

responsible_pass_behavior.behavior: The frontend optimizer's conditional-flow canonicalization does not merge these source CFG shapes before code generation. Their branch direction, temporary boolean materialization, and result-block layout remain distinct at codegen entry.
responsible_pass_behavior.name: IRO_OptimizeFunction
responsible_pass_behavior.not_claimed: The codegen-entry divergence proves that the forms are not merged by the completed frontend pipeline; it does not isolate a particular subpass as the first non-change without a decoded frontend-IR capture.

relevant_subpasses.name: IRO_SimplifyConditionals
relevant_subpasses.observed_behavior: Iterates flow blocks and rebuilds the flow graph only after a conditional simplification reports a change.

relevant_subpasses.name: IRO_SimplifyIfThenElse
relevant_subpasses.observed_behavior: Recognizes a two-successor conditional shape and can nop an if when successor forms qualify.
